plan.title: Mouse liver HFD vs chow DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a raw Salmon gene-level count matrix (12000 genes x 12 mouse liver samples) with a balanced 6-vs-6 high-fat-diet vs chow design, single batch, unpaired. One caveat flagged in the data profile: sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median. Per grounded best practice (R-0008/R-0030), this sample is kept through QC and inspected, not dropped by default — DESeq2's size-factor normalization accounts for depth, and removal is only justified by a concrete QC finding (outlier on PCA/sample-distance heatmap, not depth alone). The pipeline: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library size/detected-gene bar plots) to characterize sample_01 and confirm no other batch/outlier structure; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter; (3) DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization; (4) explicit-reference-level design (chow as reference, HFD as numerator) with DESeq2 Wald test; (5) apeglm shrinkage of log2FoldChanges for reporting/ranking; (6) BH-adjusted multiple testing (alpha=0.05) with independent filtering, p-value histogram inspected; (7) fgsea preranked GSEA on the full ranked list (DESeq2 Wald statistic) against the MSigDB mouse Hallmark collection (2026.1, staged in the reference store) to find coordinated pathway-level shifts, since a hard significance cutoff would likely yield too few genes for a reliable over-representation test; (8) an integrated report combining the DE gene table, fit diagnostics, hallmark GSEA results with leading-edge genes, and explicit documentation of the sample_01 depth caveat and how it was handled.

steps.method: vst(blind), PCA, sample distance heatmap, library size bar plot
keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
~condition, explicit reference level = chow, contrast HFD vs chow
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB mouse Hallmark gene sets
integrated DE + hallmark GSEA report with QC diagnostics, MA/dispersion plots, leading-edge genes, session info
